doctors.qualification: MDS (Periodontics & Implantology), Fellowship in Laser Dentistry
doctors.bio: Dr. Aishwarya P leads Aishwarya Dental Clinic and Implant Centre in Vidyanagar, Guntur. Her master's degree (MDS) is in Periodontics and Implantology: the branch of dentistry that deals with the gums, the bone holding each tooth in place, and dental implants that replace teeth which have been lost. She has also completed a fellowship in laser dentistry. Where a laser suits the problem, such as reshaping gums or treating gum pockets, it can mean less bleeding and a more comfortable recovery. She will tell you plainly when a conventional approach is the better choice. Because so much of dentistry depends on healthy foundations, she begins every new patient's visit with a careful look at the gums and bone before planning fillings, root canals, aligners or a smile makeover. You leave with a written plan, the number of visits it usually takes and the cost, before any treatment begins.

_note_doctorsNotInImporter: The importer does not set appointmentDurationMinutes or weekly schedules. Apply afterwards via the admin API: PUT /clinics/{id}/doctors/{doctorId} {appointmentDurationMinutes: 15}, then POST /clinics/{id}/doctors/{doctorId}/schedules per day (Monday–Saturday, 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM; Sunday closed). No photos: initials avatars.

faqs.question: When is the clinic open?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday–Saturday, 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM; Sunday closed. For a dental emergency outside these hours, call our emergency line on the clinic number.

faqs.question: How do I find the clinic?
faqs.answer: We are at 4-5-57, beside Sai Baba Road, opp. EMGEE House, Vidyanagar, Guntur, Andhra Pradesh 522007. Search for Aishwarya Dental Clinic in Google Maps or tap 'Get directions' on the contact page.

faqs.question: What does a periodontist do?
faqs.answer: A periodontist is a dentist who has trained further, at master's level, in gum health and in the jawbone that anchors each tooth. They treat gum disease, loose teeth and receding gums, and place dental implants.

faqs.question: Will I know the cost before treatment?
faqs.answer: Yes. After the examination Dr. Aishwarya explains your options, the usual number of visits and the fee for each before anything begins.

faqs.question: Do I need an appointment?
faqs.answer: An appointment means you are seen at a set time with little waiting. Walk-ins are welcome, and we will see you as soon as a chair is free.

faqs.question: Do you treat children?
faqs.answer: Yes, children are welcome for check-ups and simple treatment. First visits are kept short and friendly.
